name: Martin AI
description: Martin AI offers AI-powered productivity features. GAIA provides a more comprehensive approach with deep integrations, proactive automation, and complete source-available transparency.
metaTitle: Martin AI vs GAIA: Source-Available AI That Acts First
metaDescription: Martin AI vs GAIA: Martin AI answers when asked but never acts first; GAIA triages email, manages tasks, and runs workflows across your tools. Free tier.
intro: Martin AI aims to bring AI assistance to daily productivity tasks. GAIA operates at a fundamentally different scale: it is a complete productivity operating system that proactively manages your entire digital workflow. With deep integrations, graph-based memory, and full source-available transparency, GAIA goes beyond answering questions to actually doing your work.

rows.gaia: Complete productivity OS that proactively manages email, calendar, tasks, workflows, and the rest of your tools
rows.competitor: Personal AI assistant reachable by phone, SMS, WhatsApp, email, Slack, and iOS/web app, with CC-to-schedule and inbox help

rows.gaia: Watches your emails, calendar, and notifications to act before you ask
rows.competitor: Reaches out with reminders and follow-ups; depth of initiative varies by connected tools

rows.gaia: Deep integrations: Gmail, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, Todoist, Asana, ClickUp, and more
rows.competitor: Calendar (Google, Apple, Outlook), inbox, Slack, and to-dos through its own connectors

rows.gaia: Graph-based memory that connects your work and learns your patterns over time
rows.competitor: Learns preferences over conversations; no cross-tool graph memory

rows.gaia: Multi-step automated workflows with triggers, conditions, and cross-tool actions
rows.competitor: Assistance with scheduling, drafts, reminders, and calls; no multi-step cross-tool workflow engine

rows.gaia: Self-host for complete data control, never trains on your data when self-hosted when self-hosted

gaiaAdvantages: Deep integrations with deep tool orchestration
Source-available with self-hosting for total data control
competitorAdvantages: May offer simpler onboarding for basic use cases
Focused feature set for specific productivity tasks
verdict: Choose Martin AI if you want focused AI productivity assistance for specific tasks. Choose GAIA if you want a comprehensive, source-available productivity OS that proactively manages your entire digital workflow with deep integrations and persistent memory.

faqs.question: How is GAIA different from Martin AI?
faqs.answer: GAIA is a complete productivity operating system. It proactively manages your email, calendar, tasks, and workflows across your integrations. It is source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) with self-hosting support and uses graph-based memory to learn your work patterns.
